description: Find a ready-to-run Carbone example: when the user wants to try Carbone, needs a starting template, or asks how to build a kind of document (invoice, label, report, contract, e-invoice...) or use a feature (loop, chart, barcode...). Each example is a real template (DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, ODT, HTML, SVG, CSV, XML, IDML...) with its JSON data, the document it produces, and a page explaining its tags. Each comes with renderArguments: pass them, unchanged, to render_document to fill it with its data (converting it is optional). inspect_template on its template URL lists the data it expects; upload_template keeps it in the account to adapt. No argument: the newest examples and the use cases.

kind.description: "gallery": complete business documents. "format-guide": one feature of one format, for beginners.

query.description: Keywords, e.g. "invoice barcode", "excel chart", "shipping label", "pdf form".

useCase.description: A use case: finance, logistics, reports, compliance, tickets, planning, presentations, publishing.

name: find_template_examples

conversion.description: Optional, for information: what to add to renderArguments to get the format the example shows (e.g. PDF).

preview.description: An image of the result, to show the user before rendering anything.

renderArguments.description: The render_document arguments that fill this template with its data, to pass as they are: the result keeps the template's format.

total.description: How many examples match (more than listed when above the limit).

title: Template Examples
